name: move_item
summary: Move an item, or part of a stack, into a slot with the game's own moves, as an inventory click does: one move, or up to 64 in order. Never through the world, so nothing perishable is left loose. force is a cheat.

help.text: One move: reference_id, quantity (part of a stack; the rest stays), to_id (the thing holding the slot) and to_slot (an index, or "auto": a matching stack first when merge allows and the whole stack moves, else the first empty slot that takes it). Or moves: up to 64 such objects, each with its own result. A refused move changes nothing for it. force true (a cheat, one move only: ask the user first) also fills a hidden slot (topic force).
help.keys: index, ok, reference_id, from {id, slot}, to {id, slot}, quantity_moved, merged_into, destination_reference_id, warning, results, count, success_count, error_count.

rules.summary: Stacks, merging, hidden slots, vending machines.
rules.text: A whole item moves as the game moves it (a vending machine keeps its own bookkeeping); part of a stack splits straight into the slot, as the Stacker does; a whole stack can join a matching stack (merge, default true). An item that is not a stack (a water packet, a canister) moves whole and counts as 1. auto skips slots the game's quick moves skip. An item may be moved out of a hidden slot (to rescue one put there by mistake); that also unpacks a package's items one by one and takes items out of a vending machine's store, and nothing goes back into a hidden slot, so such a move cannot be undone.

force.summary: Cheat: an item into a hidden slot, as the game's own code puts it there.
force.text: force true moves one whole item into an empty slot given by index, even a hidden one, with the game's own move, as a wrench mounts a rocket payload in a payload bay's hidden slot. The slot must be empty, not locked, its class None or the item's, and the item must accept it (the game's own reason is given); a draggable such as a rocket payload is allowed. Not for to_slot auto, part of a stack, a stack's own slot (a cable coil's) or a vault's display slots; a grower's plant and fertiliser slots keep their planting rules. Not in the moves list. Nothing checks that the game uses what is put there; a wrong item can be stuck in a slot no player reaches (move_item can take it out again).

reply.text: {index, ok, reference_id, from {id, slot} (null for an item in the world), to {id, slot}, quantity_moved, merged_into, destination_reference_id (the stack in the slot after the move), warning}. warning is the game's error when one of its calls failed part way but the slot holds the result: the move is done, so do not repeat it. The batch form adds count, success_count and error_count.

quantity.description: How many to take off the stack; left out, the whole item.

to_id.description: The thing holding the destination slot: a container, belt, suit or player.

merge.description: Let the items join a matching stack in the slot. Default true.

force.description: Cheat, default false: true puts the whole item into an empty slot by index even when it is hidden, as the game's own code does (topic force). Ask the user first.

moves.description: Up to 64 moves, applied in order, each with its own result.
